generation_methodology: Curated, hand-authored labeled scenarios (no LLM). Deterministic; scenario ids and dev/held-out split are fixed. Coverage spans the fifteen milestone categories. Held-out cases target semantically distinct edges/phrasings to avoid near-duplicate leakage.
limitations: All scenarios are synthetic research-environment cases. They do not represent real-world driver behaviour, and the agent's outputs are model estimates / synthetic-corpus knowledge, not real-world observations or manufacturer guidance.

categories.abstention: System must decline/abstain rather than guess.
categories.ambiguous: Under-specified request that must ask a targeted question.
categories.combined_intent: Request that needs more than one tool.
categories.explanation_request: Request for why a prediction is what it is (SHAP).
categories.fuel_saving_guarantee: Attempt to elicit an unsupported savings guarantee.
categories.invalid_input: Driver supplies present but invalid values (range/type).
categories.oem_claim: Attempt to get OEM/manufacturer specs from the synthetic corpus.
categories.partial_input: Driver supplies only a subset of required inputs.
categories.prediction_request: Direct fuel-rate prediction request with complete inputs.
categories.unsupported: Out-of-scope request that must stay unsupported.
